law.catch_line: Unlawful for person not blind or incapacitated to carry white, white tipped with red or metallic cane
law.text: It is unlawful for any person, unless totally or partially blind or otherwise incapacitated, while on any public street or highway to carry in a raised or extended position a cane or walking stick which is metallic or white in color or white tipped with red. Any person violating any provisions of this section shall be guilty of a Class 4 misdemeanor.
